summary: Security: `check` reports a proxy that serves stored files without authorization, and `check --fix` makes them private once DjangoLux is 1.15.3+.
highlights: SECURITY: `composer check` fails a stack whose proxy serves every /media/ file without authorization (DjangoLux stacks generated before 1.15.3).
`composer check --fix` switches an unmodified generated proxy to private media (DjangoLux stack schema 4) once the running DjangoLux is 1.15.3 or later; it validates first and archives the originals.
Folders your site shows to signed-out visitors go in DjangoLux's DLUX_PUBLIC_MEDIA (or under media/public/) before running the fix.
